page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; below the text a decorative woodcut ornament, without text; at the lower right the catchword.

main_text.l: plicat præcedentem partem quæ per terram repe-
bat, propellens in locum ejus subit, præcedens verò
se contrahens antrorsum sinum novum facit. Et
quamvis in aquæ fluxu lento, hi motus diversi par-
tium non sint manifesti. cùm tamen fluxus est rapi-
dior, adeò sunt conspicui, ut undæ alternatim sese
arcuantes, tum in rectam sese solventes serpentis for-
mam referant. Atque tunc accidit, ut, quod in arcu
valde curvato cernimus, impetu scilicet majori se
relaxare, ita partes illæ aquarum magis compressæ
Porrò spiritus ille qui è partibus compressis expri-
mitur, vicissim eas repetens ipsarum efficit proten-
sionem. Quod de aqua, idem de ignis fluxu servata proportione capiendum.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is decorative and has no printed words, so it is not transcribed. A small mark below the ornament is a speck, not text. The catchword "DE" is at the lower right. No signature is printed on this page.
